assumptions: Reviewed at plugin version 1.0.0 as shipped; no external mu-plugins override these hooks.

architecture.description: Single AJAX controller registered from the bootstrap loader; no REST or block surfaces.

trust_boundaries.description: Unauthenticated network -> wp_ajax_nopriv handler; the AJAX callback is the first trust boundary.

notes: Reachable without authentication or a valid nonce.

Hook name wp_ajax_myplugin_dynamic is built from a class property and is not statically resolvable; manually traced the property assignment in Loader::__construct and confirmed the branch is never registered for nopriv, so it is not attacker-reachable at the unauthenticated boundary.

secure_areas.description: Settings save handler uses check_admin_referer and current_user_can('manage_options') that both gate the update.

gaps: includes/legacy-form.php uses wp_verify_nonce but registers no entry point (IR coverage_gap); manually reviewed — it is dead code not included in any load path, so no reachable surface.
includes/loader.php:40 dynamic hook wp_ajax_myplugin_dynamic (SURF-2) is unresolved by static analysis; disposition recorded on SURF-2.

findings.title: Unauthenticated SQL injection in the AJAX search handler
findings.hypothesis: An unauthenticated visitor controls $_POST['q'] via wp_ajax_nopriv_myplugin_search and reaches an unprepared $wpdb->query, allowing SQL injection.
attacker_prerequisites: Network access to admin-ajax.php; no authentication and no nonce required.

trace.description: wp_verify_nonce is called but its return value is assigned and never gates execution — ineffective.
$wpdb->query("SELECT ... WHERE name LIKE '$q'") with no prepare/esc_sql.
Arbitrary SQL executes with the site's DB privileges.

defenses.description: A nonce check is present but ineffective: its boolean result is stored and never used to stop the handler.

refutations.description: Tried to refute by checking whether $wpdb->prepare wraps the query within 30 lines and whether esc_sql/intval sanitizes $q — neither is present; the raw value is concatenated into the query.

findings.impact: Unauthenticated attacker can read or modify arbitrary database contents via the search parameter.
assumptions: No web application firewall normalizes or blocks the payload in the target deployment.

tool_diagnostics.question: Does static extraction confirm the nonce guard is ineffective and the sink is unprepared?
tool_diagnostics.static_gap: Self-parse read the guard as ineffective; needed independent corroboration of guard effectiveness and prepare usage.
tool_diagnostics.result: IR guards[].is_effective=false for the nonce; sinks[].uses_prepared_statement=false for $wpdb->query — corroborates the self-parse.

limitations: Synthetic example used to exercise the output contract and the COMPLETE gate; not a real plugin review.
